scope: Authentication, RBAC, Sessions, CSRF, Injection Resistance, WebSocket Auth, Audit Trail, Frontend Access Controls, and Production Hardening
verdict: 100% HACKATHON-ACCEPTANCE COMPLETE FOR THE DEFINED P10 SECURITY SCOPE

closed_items.title: Unified Frontend API Request Client
closed_items.description: Standardized all fetch calls across API modules to include credentials: 'include', automatic X-CSRF-Token header injection on POST/PATCH/DELETE, and distinct handling for 401 AuthenticationError and 403 AuthorizationError.

closed_items.title: CSRF Token In-Memory Restoration on Session Refresh
closed_items.description: AuthContext mount lifecycle automatically requests a fresh CSRF token into memory when restoring an active session via getMe().

closed_items.title: CSRF Token Rotation Repository Persistence
closed_items.description: Updated SQLite and PostgreSQL save_session conflict update clauses to persist rotated csrf_token_hash.

closed_items.title: CSRF Header Enforcement on POST /auth/logout
closed_items.description: Added validate_csrf_token dependency to POST /api/v1/auth/logout to mitigate forced logout CSRF attacks.

closed_items.title: WebSocket Handshake Origin Validation
closed_items.description: Enforced exact-match Origin validation against SecurityConfig.allowed_origins. Untrusted origins are terminated with WebSocket close code 4403.

closed_items.title: WebSocket Wildcard Topic Expansion Authorization
closed_items.description: Expanded wildcard '*' topic subscriptions into explicit event families and filtered each against the authenticated principal's granted permissions.

closed_items.title: Session Revocation Across Devices on Password Change
closed_items.description: Implemented session_manager.revoke_all_user_sessions and cookie clearing upon successful password change.

closed_items.title: Security Database Fail-Closed in Production Mode
closed_items.description: Configured get_security_repository to strictly require PostgreSQL in production mode (SENTINEL_ENV=production) and raise RuntimeError on failure without silent fallback to SQLite.

closed_items.title: Interactive OpenAPI Documentation Disabled in Production
closed_items.description: Configured FastAPI application to set docs_url=None, redoc_url=None, openapi_url=None in production mode.

closed_items.title: Protected Readiness & Metrics Endpoints
closed_items.description: Enforced Permission.SYSTEM_READ on GET /ready and Permission.METRICS_READ on GET /metrics, while preserving public unauthenticated liveness on GET /health.

closed_items.title: GET /api/v1/routes/{registration} Default Non-Mutating
closed_items.description: Set persist=False default on route queries to maintain pure read idempotency on GET requests.

closed_items.title: Alert Acknowledgement Actor Derived Authoritatively from Session
closed_items.description: Overrode client-supplied acknowledged_by payload with principal.username from validated session token.

closed_items.title: Last Active Administrator Safeguard
closed_items.description: Fixed enum comparison to prevent demoting or disabling the last active admin account.

closed_items.title: Compensating Transaction on Audit Failure
closed_items.description: Implemented compensating rollback of user creation mutations if fail_closed audit trail recording raises an exception.

closed_items.title: Admin User Management and Audit Trail UI
closed_items.description: Delivered dedicated UsersPage (/admin/users) and AuditPage (/audit), Header user status pill, and RBAC action filtering.
